confidence.override: Decided by a reviewer or a repo-managed override.
confidence.source: The definition's / report's own category, mapped through the curated table.
confidence.derived-high: App rule on a section number or a curated check category.

confidence.unmapped: Nothing matched; the item is in 'Other' and in the review queue.

disclaimer: Indicative related controls only. The mapping is an app-curated reporting aid built from high-level family names and identifiers. It is not a compliance claim, an assessment against any framework or a certification. A policy or check counts once per domain; framework families overlap, so family counts are distinct counts per family and must not be added up.
labels: A domain is an app-curated grouping (taxonomy v2); it is not a benchmark or certification mapping. Every item shows where its domain came from and how much to trust it.
A policy or check counts once per domain. Policy compliance % (evaluations) and machine check pass rate (check results) have different grains and are never combined.
